connector.name: Google Calendar by pulsemcp.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Google Calendar integration with service account support and domain-wide delegation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package google-calendar-workspace-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: GCAL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_EMAIL
env.description: Service account email address from Google Cloud Console.

env.name: GCAL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Service account private key in PEM format from Google Cloud Console.

env.name: GCAL_IMPERSONATE_EMAIL
env.description: Email address of the user whose calendar to access via domain-wide delegation.

env.name: ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (readonly or readwrite).
